headline: BAL @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 4.03 at LAD 4.66, with a projected total of 8.69. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAD: BAL moved -0.57 runs while LAD moved -0.32, changing the projected margin by -0.25 runs. The projected total fell -0.89, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Brandon Young has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Kyle Tucker, Mookie Betts, Pete Alonso, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Alex Freeland because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
